title: 3D product box from dieline
original_prompt: Assemble the dieline into a flawless 3D box with accurate panels, clean folds, undistorted type, and artwork preserved exactly. Shoot it upright at a refined three-quarter angle in a minimal premium studio setting with a soft neutral background, diffused light, subtle shadows, no props, true colours, matte paperboard texture. The box front reads "AURAE / COLD-BREW MATCHA / 12 fl oz" in clean sans-serif. Side panel shows small ingredient list in 8pt type.
author: wuyoscar
why_it_is_good: Product preservation + text rendering in one production prompt.
